blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College key cog Jude Bagay knew exactly where the Generals went wrong in their Game 1 loss to defending champion San Beda in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball Final Four on Monday. Without beating around the bush, Bagay expressed frustration over the squad’s poor free-throw shooting. “We just lost due to our lapses and the breaks of the game, especially our free-throw shooting,” Bagay told the Inquirer.
